summary.motive: Punish soft bail coverage by selling a post stem and converting into a wheel that attacks the vacated outside third behind the corner's back.
summary.keyDefender: Left Corner (soft bail with eyes on QB)
summary.whyItWorks: The post stem freezes both the corner and the middle-third safety toward the middle, so the wheel breaks into space no defender is watching.
summary.failureMode: The corner plays with true outside leverage instead of bailing soft, squeezing the wheel against the sideline before it can build speed.

beats.title: 1. The Pre-Snap Leverage Read
beats.text: X aligns and sees a soft-bail corner with eyes for the quarterback rather than a press shadow. The wheel is live before the snap; the post is only the sales pitch.

beats.title: 2. The Post Stem Sells the Middle
beats.text: X pushes an aggressive inside stem that reads like a post, pulling the free safety's attention and confirming the corner's belief that help is not needed outside.

beats.title: 3. The Conversion to Wheel
beats.text: Reading the corner still flat-footed and staring at the QB, X plants off the stem and wheels outside into the void behind the bail.

beats.title: 4. The Sideline Shot
beats.text: The five-step timing arrives exactly as X rounds the wheel. The throw goes over the corner's late turn with the middle-third safety leaning the wrong way.

relations.tell: The receiver plants off an inside stem and accelerates away from the numbers — a called post never leaves its diagonal track.
